title: Remove Create from Design Toolbar
description: Remove the create tool/section from the Design app toolbar in the sketchpad
summary: Removed DesignToolbarCreate component and its toolbar section registration from the Design app. The create group (with addPiece button) is no longer shown in the Design toolbar. Filter toolbar remains intact. No compilation errors.
